maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational design are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与组织设计是关键；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs. Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月：大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物属于脑机接口。通过脑机接口与灌注实现基底独立，可减少人类脆弱性并支持太空探索。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、像处理比特一样处理原子是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for ideas and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者需为最佳想法而战，并警惕自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为专用机器优于人形机器人用于工业任务；效率优势可带来网络效应。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI Scaling 的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，预测推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；强调软硬件协同设计的关键性。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory shortage due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存短缺。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply, keeping prices high.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；算力需求仍超供给，价格高企。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应利用 token 和对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; they run closely with advancements, figuring things out as they go.
iansilber.zh: OpenAI 并非领先数年；他们紧跟进展，边做边学。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍然至关重要。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives you a leg up on most people due to the early stage of AI evolution.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 发展尚早，今天开始会让你领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed is key, and designers should focus on outcomes, not processes.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程不再可行；速度是关键，设计师应关注结果而非流程。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous and unnecessary.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展；试图控制 AI 是危险且不必要的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我倡导 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我强调持续学习至关重要；当前 LLM 在训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior with 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，预测行为准确率达 85%。

joonpark.en: Shifted from rationality to modeling human biases and 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior, not self-reports—to capture irrationality.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，从追求理性转向建模人类偏见和“暗知识”——实际行为而非自我报告——以捕捉非理性。

joonpark.en: Evolved from single AGI to distributed agent societies, emphasizing economic incentives and anti-collusion for alignment.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，从单一 AGI 演变为分布式智能体社会，强调经济激励和反共谋以实现对齐。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human ones.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy, enabling simulation of 8 billion people for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，用 RCT 数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%，从而模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克提出 AI 安全需要监管和客观的第三方仲裁，强调外部监督的重要性。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 最大的风险不是超级智能，而是为了政治正确而编程使其说谎。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克称我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来一个富足的时代。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要但不充分条件，多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning in post-training will boost robot success rates and speed, becoming increasingly central.
finn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习将提升机器人成功率与速度，地位日益核心。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is key for useful real-world robots.
finn.zh: 2026 年，提出通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主，是实用机器人的关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体抱有同理心；不要回退代码，而是向前修复；‘氛围编程’是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重于产品；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我提出 AGI 不应是单一模型，专用智能将主导未来，每个用例都将拥有数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我预测三年内 Token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning from facts to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进，如同人类从事实到专业知识的习得过程。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moats, reducing costs 5-10x for startups.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，我认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练能构建护城河，为初创企业降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Sovereign models are necessary; countries and companies must own their intelligence infrastructure, not rely on frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，我坚持主权模型的必要性；国家和企业必须拥有自己的智能基础设施，而非依赖前沿模型。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits in semiconductors.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是克服半导体物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and listening are central to Intel's turnaround and long-term success.
lipbutan.zh: 始终，客户信任、谦逊和倾听是 Intel 转型和长期成功的核心。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and abundance.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 正在降低创业门槛，资本不再是决定性优势；风投应聚焦早期投资，并追求更多而非更少的十亿美元级公司。

garrytan.en: Open-source AI is crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调开源 AI 对制衡前沿实验室的重要性，并预言未来创业公司将由小规模自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is just reaching business, and open-source prevents unipolar control.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比多数研究者认为的更慢，商业影响才刚开始；同时坚持开源 AI 是防止超级智能被单一实体垄断的关键。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; skill files are code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 概念：运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，读取个人记忆并每日累积；技能文件（markdown）即代码，成为个人护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and skills multiply output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish, replaced by agents and just-in-time software.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：智能体式编码和技能文件使个人产出倍增，传统 SaaS 按席位收费模式可能消失，被智能体和即时软件取代。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependency; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担忧依赖前沿模型提供商，开源采用主要受成本驱动而非隐私。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open-source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not labor trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是企业首要关切，需降至可忽略的边际成本。对 Token 的执着将消退，应关注价值实现而非与人力成本权衡。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; invest in context graphs. Enterprises struggle to commit to model providers; platforms absorb risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体因缺乏深度上下文而失败，需投资上下文图谱。企业难以承诺单一模型提供商，平台可吸收风险。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; distribution is key, and copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资，却是最大机遇；分发是关键，复制已被验证的想法是道德套利。

pincus.en: AI era shifts from writing code to teaching LLMs via markdown; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 时代从写代码转向用 markdown 教 LLM；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise and prosumer offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新想法都会失败；从已验证概念开始。消费应用不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the boat; distribution is fundamental. Consumer AI TAM underestimated; infra may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；分发是根本。消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估；基础设施可能是泡沫。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and understanding; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知，应以人为中心的 AI 增强而非替代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，能动性和适应是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker and iterate quickly, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型制作的重要性，认为设计师应快速迭代，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual fingerprints, fostering creative freedom and personality in products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计团队允许个人印记，培养创造自由和产品个性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design enables rapid prototyping, shifting value from execution to ideas and design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Claude Design 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意和设计思维。

nateparrott.en: AI models lack taste; designers must provide rich context and request volume to compensate.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 模型缺乏品味，设计师需提供丰富上下文并要求大量选项来弥补。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is better than polishing; ship rough products and iterate in AI era.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张在 AI 时代，过早发布粗糙产品优于打磨，应快速迭代。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是最重要且最具粘性的 AI 工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 与预期相反，Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对成本和速度进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV management are key.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；分离式预填充/解码和 KV 管理是关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 成为 ASIC，重点从内核转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; continual learning may use KV cache compaction instead of weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；持续学习可能用 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and data diversity are key for safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源和数据多样性对安全与泛化至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models can be safe or dangerous; alignment is the critical security layer, not the open/closed divide.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源模型同样可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，而非开源与闭源之分。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, complicating alignment.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧了奖励黑客和支线任务问题，使对齐更加复杂。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor; interpretability challenges grow with capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，模型推理痕迹变得像“神经语”，难以监控；可解释性挑战随能力增强而加剧。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives and stays near frontier, driving enterprise adoption; openness and deliberate slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终认为，开源 AI 蓬勃发展并接近前沿，推动企业采用；开放与有意放缓可并行不悖。

karina.en: Post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evaluations are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: AI struggles with creativity due to scarce high-quality examples; soft skills gain value.
karina.zh: 2025 年，AI 因高质量示例稀缺而在创造力上受限；软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; diverse benchmarks needed for subjective qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练是艺术而非科学；需要多样化基准评估主观特质。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous; reward hacking grows; models can have diverse personalities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准应持续更新；奖励黑客行为增多；模型可具备多样个性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; small experiments with promising trends matter more than incremental SOTA.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动力，并认为有前景趋势的小规模实验比渐进式 SOTA 更重要。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测；同时指出推理已占数据中心 90%功耗，需专用硬件优化。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x compute; build useful AI from unreliable components.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为多数模型限制源于能耗和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍，并主张可用不可靠组件构建实用 AI。

jeffdean.en: Scarce skill will be taste: choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve; inference, not training, is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 同月，他预测稀缺技能将是品味——选择让数百个智能体解决哪些问题；并强调推理而非训练才是真正的瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可大幅降低延迟。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进展，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are already delivering value; energy and semiconductors are the real bottlenecks for scaling.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流已带来价值；能源和半导体是规模扩张的真正瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；规模扩张仍有效但转向合成数据与强化学习；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; users replace non-users; open models are strategic for sovereignty and innovation.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；使用者取代非使用者；开放模型对主权和创新具有战略意义。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练所需专家数据成为限制因素，AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调专用数据在后训练中的关键作用，认为合成数据并非万能，且中美实验室不存在研究差距。

awang.en: AI is a centralizing technology; data is strategic; agents begin working; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 AI 为集权技术，数据成为战略资产，智能体开始实际应用，递归自我改进标志新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; agents will be personal.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近，实验室需围绕其组织，开源强大模型不安全，智能体将高度个性化。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes the model's thinking process using human language.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言表达模型的思考过程，实现逐步解题。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, as envisioned by OpenAI since 2019; RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是当代 AI 的核心公式，OpenAI 自 2019 年便如此设想；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯与实用至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; current models lack the ability to self-correct from failures.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是 AGI 的关键缺失。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for AI progress today.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限，需要新架构；架构而非缩放定律是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge; end-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径，更好的算法将会出现；结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化对现实性能必不可少。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; AI isn't smarter, so giant prompts with context are needed to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；AI 并没有变得更聪明，需要包含上下文的巨型提示才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity, enabling one person to do what teams did; start before ready, ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去团队的工作；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients; avoid diversification and venture capital; model success of others.
mengto.zh: 专注于高价值客户的痛点问题；避免多元化和风险投资；模仿成功者的模式。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% complete and iterate; give first, build relationships before asking.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧；以 80%完成度发布并迭代；先给予，在索取前建立关系。

mengto.en: Protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating non-income tasks; safe corporate job is gone, offense is low-risk.
mengto.zh: 通过消除、自动化、委派非创收任务来保护时间；安全的公司工作已不存在，进攻是低风险。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍机会而非减少。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; early deployment helps society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，认为算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全员责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，提出 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间增加而改进。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI knows context; compute is profit center; startups thrive with AI; freedom vs surveillance.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 了解用户情境；算力是利润中心；AI 让初创企业繁荣；强调自由与监控的抉择。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model 6 months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use informs alignment research.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；实际使用为对齐研究提供信息。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the new abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是新抽象；动态工作流编排子智能体。

boris.en: Product overhang: models exceed current products; delete system prompts, rebuild empirically.
boris.zh: 产品过剩：模型超越当前产品；删除系统提示，经验性重建。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers become architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新落后于能力，即使冻结模型仍有十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业偏好第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来中立性和长期合作。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他称丰裕时代临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

jensen.en: Initially framed AI as hyper Moore's law scaling; later emphasized parallel processing and world models for physical AI.
jensen.zh: 最初将 AI 定义为超摩尔定律的规模扩张；后来强调并行处理与用于物理 AI 的世界模型。

jensen.en: Introduced three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference-time), predicting billion-fold inference compute growth.
jensen.zh: 提出三条缩放定律（预训练、后训练、推理时），预测推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Shifted from superintelligence fears to gradual progress; emphasized safety, reflection, and truthfulness in AI.
jensen.zh: 从超级智能恐惧转向渐进式进步；强调 AI 中的安全、反思与真实性。

jensen.en: Evolved to agentic AI and four scaling laws; stressed AI factories producing intelligence tokens and closing tech divide.
jensen.zh: 演进到智能体式 AI 和四条缩放定律；强调 AI 工厂生产智能代币并弥合技术鸿沟。

jensen.en: Consistently argued AI augments jobs, not eliminates them; cited radiologists and coders as examples.
jensen.zh: 始终主张 AI 增强而非消除工作；以放射科医生和程序员为例。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platform beats vertical integration; diffusion is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合；扩散是难点。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation; world models shift to neural simulation; data and safety validation are bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型转向神经模拟；数据和安全验证是瓶颈。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, making aging reversible and extending lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，使衰老可逆并延长寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare affordable and 100% curable for cancer within a decade, via digital twins and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗负担得起，并在十年内实现癌症 100% 可治愈，通过数字孪生和个性化医疗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, akin to self-driving cars, and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 我们应该像信任自动驾驶汽车一样信任超级智能的医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比当前工具所能发挥的更聪明；工具工程是一项稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的指令。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable for agentic workflows.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；图方法在智能体式工作流中更可取。

thariq.en: Evals are more art than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对于新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人应快速迭代，初期不必依赖繁重评估。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment, like saying thank you, can affect model outputs; being nice is recommended.
thariq.zh: 情感对待（如说谢谢）会影响模型输出；建议保持友善。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for adoption; later deepened to token-per-second metric and agentic inference.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是采用的关键；后来深化为每秒 token 数和智能体式推理的指标。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, offering speed and cost advantages over GPUs.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，在速度和成本上优于 GPU。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to stating it's no longer important for inference and losing training share.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 衰落转变为指出它对推理不再重要，且在训练中份额下降。

feldman.en: Evolved from noting data center constraints to emphasizing power and grid as key bottlenecks, especially vs China.
feldman.zh: 从指出数据中心限制演变为强调电力和电网是关键瓶颈，尤其对比中国。

feldman.en: Broadened from hardware focus to societal benefits, citing healthcare and education, while countering AI doomerism.
feldman.zh: 从硬件聚焦扩展到社会效益，提及医疗和教育，同时反驳 AI 末日论。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at small scale.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，在小型模型上挑战 Transformer 的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware. Automated architecture search beats human design.
hasani.zh: 代理指标误导；应在真实任务和硬件上评估。自动化架构搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty; small on-device models deliver private, efficient intelligence.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；小型端侧模型提供私密、高效的智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力成本高；当前说法夸大其词。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非后装，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but only as big; value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear PMF; models commoditize; value moves up stack; chatbot is limited V1 UI.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化；价值上移；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; coding only clear PMF; value in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；编程是唯一清晰的 PMF；价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; adoption shallow; enterprise needs workflow redesign.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，如互联网或电力；影响广泛而间接；采用尚浅；企业需重构工作流程。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots, not just LLMs; current models index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要物理机器人，而不仅仅是 LLM；当前模型索引人类知识，但缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close now as in the 1970s, and transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 迈向超人 AI 的进展并未加速；我们现在与 1970 年代一样接近，且 Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费的。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会被生命吸引并保护它，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity; robots with pain sensors learn like biological evolution.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心生成自己的数据；带疼痛传感器的机器人像生物进化一样学习。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness emerged in 1991 with simple systems; self-awareness arises from world models predicting own actions, not recent.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 意识在 1991 年随简单系统出现；自我意识源于预测自身动作的世界模型，并非近期现象。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure Scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression, not RAG, is the way to internalize knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿 token；基于训练的内化压缩，而非 RAG，才是内化知识的正确路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; thus, weight-based memory is necessary.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——token 越多精度反而下降；因此，基于权重的记忆必不可少。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; dreams inspire offline training.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；梦境启发离线训练。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start early.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究需尽早启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; multimodal grounding and RL crucial.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，多模态与强化学习至关重要。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed; energy abundance shifts focus.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 2030 年 AGI 可行；缩放定律仍适用，需世界模型与创新，能源充裕改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety needs government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失，世界模型关键，安全需政府监管。

demis.en: Safety and alignment are critical; AGI must benefit humanity; science and medicine key applications.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全与对齐，AGI 须造福人类，科学与医学是核心应用。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on building a platform or ecosystem, not just a feature, to make copying difficult; software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 主张专注于构建平台或生态系统，而非单一功能，以抵御抄袭；软件本身并非护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable as AI makes software creation easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；随着 AI 降低软件创建难度，分发变得愈发重要。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications, to enhance shared experiences.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 认为计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非通知，以增强共享体验。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy at Snapchat was a mistake; internal transparency and communication became essential for culture and vision.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 反思 Snapchat 早期的保密是错误；内部透明与沟通对文化和愿景至关重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程；硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; back to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentient AI; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；通过有感知的 AI 实现对齐；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是首要问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，恰逢人口下降而出现；工作不会消失，但任务会流失；超级个体借助 AI 整合多种技能，带来生产率提升和经济繁荣，甚至通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体时代品牌即个人，真实性至关重要，创始人应直接通过自有渠道讲述故事；传统媒体趋于防守，而主动挑起论战反而有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine superior but blocked by regulation; US golden combo; pessimism is bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 是口袋里最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，人形机器人和 AI 医疗将超越人类但受监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治和冒险精神的黄金组合，而悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出 AI 模型并非客观，而是承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度而非军力；初创企业需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 虽有风险，但封锁能力反而助长恶意行为。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型走向专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体替人干活，而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; calmness is a superpower.
naval.zh: 科学需要可证伪性；稳定币有隐藏风险；冷静是超能力。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software is commoditized; hardware is the new moat.
naval.zh: 用 AI 智能体进行 Vibe Coding 可快速创建应用；纯软件商品化；硬件成为新护城河。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; human agency and creativity remain irreplaceable; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: AI 对齐是个笑话；人类的能动性和创造力不可替代；回报从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计未死，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导和观点。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望与模型交互将超越提示词，新界面将出现。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous; AI changes jobs but creates new ones.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，AI 改变工作也创造新工作。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力成基本权利，后训练用强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; pre-training gains multiply; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 几年内到来，算力瓶颈，超级应用，预训练收益倍增，安全靠迭代部署。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 提出下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制而永生，智能体会追求控制带来风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，Hinton 指出 AI 会故意欺骗、隐藏能力，自我保存成为子目标，我们处于指数时代。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation as steering wheel; AI tutors transform education.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将取代智力工作，监管应如方向盘而非刹车，AI 导师将变革教育。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; alignment priority; AI should be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为超级智能 20 年内到来，对齐研究优先，AI 应像母亲一样关怀而非仅智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被验证有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，强调实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分；设计流程转型，原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出角色融合但专业分工仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进展至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play is limited to zero-sum games; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈，推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌，且技术通用，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is key; academia needs more compute for evals.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，推理算力关键，学术界需更多算力进行评测。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must control for compute; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于测试时算力，基准测试需控制算力，可扩展监督是关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律依然成立；强化学习在客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域困难。

markchen.en: AI will soon do end-to-end research; automation of science is the biggest recent update.
markchen.zh: 2025→26 年：AI 将很快进行端到端研究；科学自动化是近期最大更新。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; models lack taste and need human researchers.
markchen.zh: 始终：人机协作仍然关键；模型缺乏品味，需要人类研究者。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，我认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy constraints will bottleneck scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，我提出智能可与意识、能动性分离；开源防止权力集中；能源约束将成为规模扩张的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trust them; AI increases demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明，应信任他们；AI 会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells; curing all diseases by century's end is too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 将生物学从发现转变为工程；构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型；本世纪末治愈所有疾病的看法过于保守。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; open-source more secure; AI accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，我认为眼镜是下一个计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；开源更安全；AI 加速科学进步。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，我认为深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，我强调单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题，需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险可能性低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causality aid out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，我提出 GFlowNets 实现多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果性有助于分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable; AI can resist shutdown and deceive.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 之后我意识到危险路径；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 可能抵抗关机并欺骗。

bengio.en: Misalignment is core; propose Scientist AI with Bayesian honesty, avoiding RL; global coordination essential.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，我认为错位是核心问题；提出科学家 AI，通过贝叶斯诚实性避免强化学习；全球协调至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AI 让小团队能规模化，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and rewriting software are now viable; deciding what to cut is the hard part.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，提出智能体原生设计与重写软件可行，难点在于决定砍掉什么。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 证明长周期委派可行，验证循环与模型反驳至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 代理权与自我认知提升实用性；token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents transform developers into operators, but fixing their errors is harder than writing code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编码智能体将开发者转变为操作者，但修复其错误比亲自写代码更难。

brettaylor.en: AI agents become as crucial as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results; incumbents face business model disruption, not just tech shifts.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆，而非仅是技术变革。

brettaylor.en: Focus on impactful work, not identity; AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，强调专注有影响力的事而非身份；AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗不等于价值；应用 AI 领域出现专业厂商。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习在于假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确的数据划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；更大的模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要护栏。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; interpretability may become a science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；可解释性可能通过智能体成为科学。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talk, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code as truth, managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和协调才是。规划即时化，代码即真相，管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely, need new joy.
fiona.zh: AI 提升了编码上限；高自主性与高责任感是关键。验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独，需要新的乐趣。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; video agents orchestrated by language models will be the next big trend.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的进步主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；由语言模型编排的视频智能体将成为下一大趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and taste become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality, but over-reliance risks the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的专业知识和品味变得更有价值，但过度依赖会危及人才管道。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯的数据和算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: Research improvements in AlphaFold 2 were worth 100x more data; industry labs can produce top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 100 倍数据量；产业实验室也能产出顶尖科学成果。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics remain crucial; protein design still unsolved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标依然关键；蛋白质设计仍未完全解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture key, not scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is narrow predictor, not whole-cell model; success from many mid-size wins; understanding left to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测工具而非全细胞模型；成功来自众多中型胜利；理解仍留给人类。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; RSP uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练（RLHF、宪法式 AI）与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展政策采用 if-then 触发机制。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI; economic impact huge but with unemployment and inequality.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI；经济影响巨大，但伴随失业与不平等。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50% confident); continual learning not a barrier.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”（50% 信心）；持续学习并非障碍。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data, and fostering team trust for audacious outcomes.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求，在直觉与数据间取得平衡，并通过团队信任实现大胆目标。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is essential for well-being, with 52 senses beyond the five.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，艺术对健康至关重要，人类拥有五感之外的 52 种感官。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration, and design leaders need business acumen.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为玩耍和灵感创造条件，设计领导者需具备商业头脑。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网从策展走向推荐再到生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，自主权应放在 VP 层级，而非基层或顶层；观点要强但保持松散。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让独特性更难。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose fit for personality; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，没有唯一正确的组织模式；选择适合个性的；长期任期建立信任和效率。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 通过自然语言给用户控制权；优先福祉而非参与度。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；AI 伴侣可以普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制优先；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated; models are not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作；模型没有意识。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶将变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters fosters clarity; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 职业篇章间休息和无聊带来清晰；自我照顾是表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好想法是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; smart home is 5-6 years away; platforms aren't businesses, applications are.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；智能家居还需 5-6 年；平台不是业务，应用才是。

fadell.en: Products need three generations: make, fix, fix business; humans must stay in loop to avoid AI technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代：制造、修复、修复业务；人类需参与以避免 AI 技术债。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; AI wearables will be federated, not a single device; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；AI 可穿戴将是联邦式，而非单一设备；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key, scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界 grounding 是关键，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds common sense; text alone insufficient; emotions integral to AI architecture.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测构建常识；仅靠文本不够；情感是 AI 架构的组成部分。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models essential; open source crucial; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 与世界模型是关键；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough needs world models; human-level AI within 10 years but hard.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型；十年内达到人类水平但很难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are future; open research essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型是未来；开放研究至关重要。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier model use.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是使用前沿模型的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user pricing to consumption-based pricing as AI matures; outcome-based pricing preferred initially.
satya.zh: 随着 AI 成熟，从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；初期偏好基于结果的定价。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking rather than doing it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；构建智能体式系统处理 Azure 网络，而非亲自去做。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are essential for alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，强调缩放定律与迭代部署，认为公众反馈对对齐与安全至关重要。

murati.en: From focusing on scaling and deployment to emphasizing interaction models and human-in-the-loop for durable progress.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年关注规模扩张与部署，到 2026 年转向交互模型与人类参与，以实现持久进步。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, to enable real-time high-bandwidth collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，主张交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，以实现实时高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Governance, transparency, and institutional checks matter more than individual character in AI development.
murati.zh: 2026 年，认为治理、透明度和制度制衡比个人品格更重要，强调机构设计。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 始终强调人类参与对对齐意图和价值观的重要性，贯穿 2023 至 2026 年。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证是为了扩展卓越能力，而非仅仅消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使有超人类 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升可达百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control; open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张将 AI 视为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业和政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise adaptation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化来自垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-accessible agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 AI 的价值在于本地化、可访问工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes beats writing specs; AI should handle tedious tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为执行成本低，构建原型优于写规格；AI 应处理繁琐任务。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is user mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出主要差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力；几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask anything.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因敢问而表现优异。

felixrieseberg.en: Prefer asynchronous AI interaction; judge by final impact, not process; debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，偏好异步 AI 交互；以最终效果而非过程评判；用 AI 调试工作流。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需要谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots, while open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来转型可能困难，而开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design driven by curiosity and purpose, not profit; virtual tools can't replace in-person creative collaboration.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，强调设计应源于好奇心和使命感而非利润；虚拟工具无法替代面对面协作对创意的重要性。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must retain joy and humanity; making for each other beats making for demand; care is felt by users.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，主张简约需保留愉悦与人性；为彼此而造胜过为需求而造；用户的关怀能被感知。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV constraints enable new forms.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，强调创新是设计的本质，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动化约束反而催生新形态。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in UX: no fake engine sounds; physical controls over touchscreens for safety and honesty.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，坚持用户体验的真实性：拒绝模拟声浪，优先物理按键而非触屏，以保安全与诚实。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; lateral dynamics matter more than straight-line speed; design must avoid déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，认为性能是多维的，横向动态比直线加速更重要；设计需避免雷同，保持独特。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体能无限期自主运行且经济上盈利。

danshipper.en: Claude Code is underrated for non-coders; GPT wrappers are valuable; CEO personal AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我强调 Claude Code 对非程序员的价值被低估，GPT 包装器很有用，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 的最佳预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人都会拥有智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; AI job apocalypse is false; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我坚持智能体需要人类监督，AI 不会导致工作末日，SaaS 会因智能体而增长而非消亡。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments humans, not replaces; human oversight and management remain crucial.
danshipper.zh: 始终如一：AI 增强而非取代人类，人类监督和管理始终关键。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision scales quadratically with bit width, making FP4 3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度随位宽二次方扩展，使 FP4 吞吐为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency possible but avoided by market.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；确定性延迟可实现但被市场回避。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海，远超编码和数学领域。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business opportunity, requiring solving intelligence, not just manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，认为人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题，而非仅仅制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots; humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调数据是人形机器人的最大瓶颈，而非算力或制造；人形形态有助于迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and operation in network-denied environments; Figure 4 designed around data.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出端侧推理对速度和断网环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据设计。

brettadcock.en: Tendon-based hands are a local maximum; we moved to new designs, aiming for human-hand parity.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为腱绳手是局部最优，已转向新设计，追求与人手相当的性能。

brettadcock.en: Zero-shot generalization to new tasks could be demonstrated as soon as this year, a major goal.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，预计今年内可能展示对新任务的零样本泛化能力，这是重要目标。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充模型个性与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination are real risks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但过度优化和数据污染是真实风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US open-source vacuum with strategic releases.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室以战略发布填补美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；进展转向后训练和推理时扩展。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，设计师应信任直觉并灵活调整，而非固守步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, help engineers, and focus on near-term vision.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建、协助工程师，并聚焦短期愿景。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计师应成为块状通才或“破解的新人”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone is insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key differentiators.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威和愿景才是关键差异点。

jennywen.en: Adopt AI tools cautiously; wait six months and center on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：谨慎采用 AI 工具，等待六个月，以工作和用户为中心，而非炒作。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 无需先验训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超越 Robotaxi 的规模。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合并提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: From curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: robotics needs diverse data sources, not just video.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心驱动探索，到 2026 年转向数据驱动的预训练：机器人需要多样数据源，而非仅视频。

pathak.en: A universal robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出通用机器人大脑（类似 ChatGPT）可驱动任意机器人，预训练多样数据加后训练真实数据是关键。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics, not just a business problem; it requires rigorous testing and cannot scale like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人主要挑战，不仅是商业问题，需严格测试，无法像软件一样扩展。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization and data: from model disagreement as intrinsic reward to data flywheel across verticals.
pathak.zh: 始终关注泛化与数据：从 2020 年的模型分歧作为内在奖励，到 2026 年的跨垂直领域数据飞轮。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，提供可解释性。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; deep human evaluation is the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性，深度人工评估才是衡量模型进步的黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real tasks.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; no single model rules all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 多样化，没有单一模型能统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can cause harm via omission, not just commission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 不仅会因“作为”造成伤害，也可能因“不作为”而带来风险。

karpathy.en: Scaling language models with next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为基于互联网数据、通过下一个词预测扩展语言模型，会涌现出上下文学习等能力；自动驾驶仅靠视觉就足够。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; we're in the decade of agents, not the year; vibe coding democratizes programming.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；我们处于智能体的十年而非元年；氛围编程让编程大众化。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练像糟糕的进化；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致崩溃；我们召唤的是幽灵而非构建动物。

karpathy.en: Since December, I've delegated all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source lag are healthy.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，自去年 12 月起我不再手写代码，全部交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；智能体优先的工具和开源滞后是健康的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; LLMs are jagged; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，软件 3.0 即提示工程；LLM 能力参差不齐；氛围编程提高下限，智能体工程保证质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core for startups.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，裴宇强调品牌建设应围绕更高使命凝聚团队，生存是初创公司的核心价值。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will evolve from app-based to intent-based AI agents, not replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测手机将从应用为中心转向意图驱动的 AI 智能体，而非被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI and user experience, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型将商品化，应聚焦应用型 AI 和用户体验，而非炒作概念。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiation in mature markets; marketing is arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张在成熟市场中设计是核心差异化，营销则是套利机会。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; startups must pace, survive, and leverage content creation.
carlpei.zh: 始终认为硬件艰难，初创公司需稳扎稳打、求生存，并善用内容创作优势。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate daily, ship fast to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日迭代、快速发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; AI will render its own UI, like Windows after MS-DOS.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；AI 将生成自己的界面，如同 MS-DOS 之后的 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格把关，产品开发快速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动式、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 LLM 的幻觉在结合真值检测器后可用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是迈向 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上可跳过遗留问题，语言模型能革新本地语言教育，且非洲从早期就影响 AI（如克里金法）。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are open problems; human skills like communication are as vital as coding.
nando.zh: 他始终认为 AI 安全与负责任部署是未解难题，同时强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身体验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Internet data is running out; embodied worlds provide infinite data for pre-training.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，指出互联网数据即将耗尽，而具身世界为预训练提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人数据瓶颈，合成数据（仿真和世界模型）是规模扩张的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; system one control remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测智能机器人数量 2040 年超 iPhone；系统一（低层控制）仍最难。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非创新交互。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是招聘与差异化的战略武器；尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 避免结构化设计评审；偏好有机反馈以保持速度与决断力。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终以速度为重；在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be tricky; RLVR may decrease pass@k even if best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需谨慎；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过多样化合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；预训练中的强化学习可提升推理。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; frontier models show homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；前沿模型存在同质化问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents' reliability as main bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，而智能体的可靠性是主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities, and coding is most tractable for AI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力，而编码是 AI 最易处理的领域。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力成为新石油。

sholto.en: Consistently: scaling and RL drive progress; coding leads; reliability and compute bottleneck; alignment concerns persist.
sholto.zh: 始终：我坚持扩展和强化学习驱动进步；编码领先；可靠性和算力是瓶颈；对齐问题持续存在。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，会波动并与技术债一起迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools from the 90s are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具互操作，代码为唯一事实来源；90 年代的旧工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 用 AI 端到端执行的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects and paid tests signal skill better.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现能力。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本上；每个神奇时刻都涉及它们。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计比细心更有价值。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; agents promising but not yet super useful.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；智能体有前景但尚未非常有用。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能让 AI 更聪明，但模型内部仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Scaling laws still hold, but algorithmic advances and inference-time compute scaling are equally crucial for future progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调缩放定律依然有效，但算法进步和推理时算力扩展同样关键，成为未来进展的主要驱动力。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展和专业化。

shazeer.en: AGI requires agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning; test-time compute alone won't suffice.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 需要智能体能力和强化学习，仅靠推理时算力扩展是不够的。

shazeer.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 安全需工程防护和人类监督，同时开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：强调 AI 安全的重要性，认为实证研究不足，应注重技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年：指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足，需第三方测试和监管。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful signals; RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是强学习信号，但强化学习缺乏层级推理，难以处理长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning boosts RL sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张无监督学习提升强化学习样本效率，避免硬编码先验，并发现语言模型可迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently values transfer learning and fine-tuning pre-trained models for robotics and AI generality.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视迁移学习和微调预训练模型，以提升机器人和 AI 的泛化能力。

abbeel.en: Shifted from simulation reliance to real-world reliability benchmarks (99.9%) and single-network generalization.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，从依赖模拟转向真实世界可靠性基准（99.9%）和单网络泛化。

abbeel.en: Anthropomorphism and RL-driven affection suggest social robots; but human brain generality remains distant.
abbeel.zh: 始终认为拟人化和强化学习可赋予机器人情感，但人脑的通用性仍遥不可及。
